heroStyle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW original collectible creature hero sprite in the approved PIXEL ART style.
Reference images are STYLE references only (Mosskip and Puddlepip); do not duplicate their species. Match their appealing Nintendo DS-era Pokémon front-sprite proportions, confident dark stepped outlines, limited color ramps, and visible blocky pixel clusters. Approximately 64–80 logical pixels tall on a 96x96 logical grid, enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbour square pixels for inspection. No smooth cartoon lines, no vector look, no watercolor, no anti-aliased edges, no soft gradients, no glossy 3D. Use 12–18 colors and 2–3 shade steps per material. One clean full-body three-quarter idle-pose sprite, centered, all appendages visible, consistent optical scale about 70% of a square canvas. Background MUST be genuinely transparent alpha (not black/white, not a checkerboard drawn into the image). No text, labels, frame, drop shadow, UI, other creatures, scenic background, or decorative props. This is an original creature with Pokémon-inspired pixel rendering, not an existing Pokémon.
iconStyle: Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE FACE-ONLY PIXEL ART ICON of the exact creature in the supplied hero image. Preserve its species identity, facial colors, eyes, ear/antenna/head-crest shapes and personality. Redraw as a simplified near-front-facing head icon designed to read at 22–32 pixels, about 28x28 logical pixels within a 32x32 logical icon grid, enlarged with visibly chunky crisp nearest-neighbour squares. Only the face/head and essential ears/antennae/crest: NO torso, limbs, tail, wings, full body, shoulders, background disc, frame or text. Crop composition by design, not by cutting off key head appendages. Large readable eyes, simple mouth/nose, strong silhouette, limited palette about 8–12 colors, dark one-logical-pixel stepped outline. Keep all pixel squares on one coarse grid, zero smooth cartoon curves, zero watercolor, zero antialiasing, no gradients, no 3D. Centered with about 10% transparent margin. Background MUST be genuinely transparent alpha, not a painted checkerboard or a black/white block.

creatures.name: Pebblit

creatures.subject: A stocky baby wombat made of smooth rounded slate-grey river stones, big square charcoal nose, two round ears, gentle amber eyes, four short sturdy legs, cream pebble belly. creatures.name: Rimelet
creatures.head: White stoat face with pale ice-blue mask, round dark eyes, two short pointed icy-blue ears, tiny midnight-blue nose.

Four small paws and ONE thick curling icy-blue tail with a rounded snowball tip. A small three-point frost tuft on its head, soft and geometric, not elaborate crystals. Playful crouch, tail curls beside it fully visible. Palette snow white, pale ice blue, muted periwinkle shadow, navy eyes. No clothing, no scarf, no many tails.

creatures.name: Breezlet
creatures.head: Cream round bird face, mint forehead, short coral beak, navy eyes, one swept-back sky-blue feather curl.

A simple bird sprite with real wing silhouettes, not an owl, not a dragon.

creatures.name: Sprottle
